source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed building fire-safety checks

1. Start with the inspection records.
2.
completion:
- Enter the date and time of the failed inspection at the top of the form.
3. Record the name and address of the building, as well as the building owner or managing agent’s contact information.
4. List the name, title, and certification number of the inspector.
5. Clearly state the purpose of the inspection, such as routine fire safety check, re-inspection after previously failed items, or a special investigation.
6. Detail each failed item by referring to the specific fire-safety code or regulation that was violated (e.g., NFPA 72, IFC 2018, etc.).
7. Use a standardized checklist to document all fire-safety systems and components that were checked. For each system, indicate the status - “PASS,” “FAIL,” or “N/A” if not applicable.
8. For each failed item: 
   - Provide a clear description of the issue, such as “Sprinkler system pipe
